chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Al-Liwat (sodomy) is what is less than the anus, and the anus is the blasphemy (kufr).'

key_terms.الْكُفْرُ: Blasphemy / Disbelief (used here in a specific technical or metaphorical sense regarding the anus)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Al-Liwat and the significance of Al-Dubur in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this concise definition from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the anatomical scope of 'Al-Liwat' as penetration below the anus, while attributing the term 'Al-Kufr' to the anus itself, reflecting the juristic view that the anus is the primary locus of the sin. This distinction highlights the specific legal and spiritual gravity placed on the organ in Shia fiqh, distinguishing the act's location from the broader concept of disbelief often associated with the people of Lot.
